nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Foundation CI container image based on Ubuntu 24.04 that installs common build tools and utilities (build-essential, curl, git, jq, openssh-client, pkg-config, python3, unzip, zip). It is the root of the layered ghcr.io/anomalyco/build/* image chain that every other container in packages/containers builds on.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses apt-get with --no-install-recommends plus immediate /var/lib/apt/lists cleanup to keep the shared base image small, since every downstream CI image inherits these layers.
